CA.rationale: Content color listing and an origin/processing tag are present for the same candidate referent/time.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red) and an explicit origin/organization field coexist for the same referent/time, showing identity, organization and a separate status attribute.

A.rationale: An explicit processing/command-related origin tag ('command_estimate' / 'feedback_through') is tied to the candidate content, relating processing to content presentation/emergence.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colored content (red) and their location sets.

D.rationale: Content identity (red positions) and a separately recorded origin/status field are both present for the same referent/time, distinguishing identity from status/organization.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/representation fields describe how contents are organized/presented (e.g. completed_record, command_estimate) for current and candidate entries.
